content.short: Burner is a low-cost hardware wallet designed for gifting crypto.
content.description: Most hardware wallets are secure, but they aren't designed for everyday use or for people new to crypto. Burner is built for daily use and gifting, removing seed phrases, extra apps, and complicated steps. Just tap the card and use it directly from a phone's browser, making crypto feel like a normal, user-friendly experience. USD II, a stablecoin for gasless gifting, enables sending and receiving crypto without worrying about Ethereum or extra fees, simplifying both giving and spending.

resources.title: What Is a Real-World Asset (RWA)? A Guide to RWAs on Base
resources.tldr: Begins at the plainest definition, a Treasury bond or a bar of gold sitting off the chain, then builds up to how those get represented on Base and where you keep them safely.

resources.title: Who Is Satoshi Nakamoto? The Suspects and the Hunt to Unmask Bitcoin's Creator
resources.tldr: Seventeen years after the genesis block nobody has proved who Satoshi is. Goes through each named suspect and what the evidence really amounts to, which is usually less than reported.

resources.title: Send Money Home Cheaper and Faster With Stablecoins
resources.tldr: Traditional remittance takes an average 6.49% per transfer and several days. Compares that against a stablecoin route without pretending the last mile is solved.
